name: componentVersion
label: Component Version
description: Select version 2 to upgrade to the new condition builder experience. Version 1 represents the existing workspace condition builder.

name: tableName
label: Table name
description: Name of the table the condition builder is using

name: encodedQuery
label: Encoded query
description: Filter string to populate the condition builder

name: hideActionBar
label: Hide action bar
description: Hide everything in the condition builder header including use existing filter, save filter, record count, and undo/redo.

name: hideLoadFilter
label: Hide option to use existing filter
description: Prevent users from accessing saved filters in the condition builder.

name: hideSaveFilter
label: Hide option to save filter
description: Hide the option to save a filter. Saved filters appear in the use existing filter list.

name: hideRecordCount
label: Hide results count
description: Hide the record count for results matching criteria.

name: hideFilterOverview
label: Hide filter overview
description: Sets whether to hide the filter overview that summarizes the condition builder

name: hideEditorDescription
label: Hide editor description
description: Hide the description that appears after Editor to provide more vertical space in the condition builder.

name: hideDotWalking
label: Hide dot walking
description: Hide dot walk to prevent users from being able to filter on related or extended tables.

name: hideSets
label: Hide new condition set option
description: Hide new condition set option to prevent users from adding comparative statements.

name: hideRelatedListQueryConditions
label: Hide the related list conditions section
description: Prevent users from including a relationship with another table in the filter.

name: hideSortBy
label: Hide 'Sort by' section
description: Hide the sort by feature in the condition builder.

name: hideSortByDescription
label: Hide 'Sort by' description
description: Hide the description that appears after sort by.

name: fieldInclusionList
label: Field inclusion list
description: An array of fields that appear when using the condition builder

name: fieldExclusionList
label: Field exclusion list
description: An array of fields that will not be included when using the condition builder (takes precedence over Field Inclusion List)

name: hideErrors
label: Hide error information
description: Hides errors for invalid field, operator, or value inputs within the condition builder

name: showReferenceLookup
label: Show reference lookup
description: Show the magnifying glass next to reference or variable type fields to allow users to open a reference list
